title: Catalog redirection action
statement: Given a Boolean $b$, a single-step action on $k$ work tapes with Boolean symbols and states in $S$, and an optional Boolean $r$, define an action with states in $(S\times\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool}))\sqcup\mathrm{Unit}$. It preserves the input-head movement and all work-tape actions, emits no symbol, and sets its successor state to the catalog redirected state determined by $b$, the original successor state, and the optional value obtained by taking the action's output when present and otherwise using $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A single-step action on $k$ work tapes with Boolean symbols and states in $S$
